sources.label: 🧩 Android patches for Viber, BeReal, MovieBox, Proton Mail, Proton VPN, TeraBox
sources.author: hxreborn
patch_list: Stops AppsFlyer, Firebase Analytics, and Facebook from collecting usage data.
Unlocks premium editing features, removes ads and the export watermark, and skips the ad before importing audio. Hides the store button. The AI tools are not included.
